name: distributed-consensus
description: Use when the user asks about consensus, Raft leader election, Paxos, quorums, split brain, etcd, ZooKeeper, KRaft, replicated logs, linearizability, fencing tokens or how many nodes tolerate failures. Explains consensus and how to use consensus systems safely. Not for application lock APIs (use backend-distributed-locking) or blockchain consensus (use blockchain-core).
